label: First record pressed at Loděnice
detail: The state-run Gramofonové závody near Prague, later GZ Media, presses its first record.

label: Rounder Records founded in Somerville
detail: Bill Nowlin, Ken Irwin and Marian Leighton Levy start the roots label in an apartment.

label: Peak plastic for US recorded music
detail: The US recording industry uses an estimated 58 million kg of plastic (academic estimate).

label: Vinyl Brazil announced
detail: A planned São Paulo plant would join Polysom, then Latin America's only plant.

label: Lead times hit 9-12 months
detail: GRAMMY.com reports industry-wide waits, against 4-6 weeks in 2018.

label: BioVinyl launched
detail: optimal media and PlastChem launch a bio-attributed PVC record.

label: Burlington Record Plant sold, set to move
detail: Equal Vision Records buys the plant, planning a July 2024 move to Albany, New York.

label: The Life of a Showgirl released
detail: It sells 1.2 million vinyl copies on day one in the US, per Luminate.

label: US vinyl passes $1 billion
detail: The RIAA's 2025 report shows vinyl revenue over $1 billion for the first time since 1983.

label: RIAA mid-year 2026
detail: US vinyl up 17.7% and CDs up 58.6% in the first half of 2026.
